_doc: Building lots and vacant buildings on the town map (world/lotBook.js, world/townPlanner.js, world/innerMap/lots.js, systems/lots.js). The planner sets lots aside along the streets before the houses fill in: count[type] of them (many in a village, few in a city: a city is built up), each width x depth tiles. Anyone may buy one — the player or an AI House or townsman — and build inside its bounds; the player builds only on a lot they hold (or out in the wilds). pricePerTile[type] × the lot's area is its price. vacant[type]: houses left standing empty in town, for rent (rentPerDay[type] gold a day, paid at each day's end; miss a day and you're put out) or for sale (salePrice[type]). ai: the chance each day, per town, that someone buys a free lot (buyChance), takes a vacant house (rentChance) or leaves one (leaveChance); buildDays from purchase to the building standing; builds: what they put up (building types with designs); buyers: townsfolk names when no House buys.
_houseBuild: A house the player raises on their own lot to let (systems/lots.js buildHouseOnLot): cost[type] gold, standing after days[type].
_letting: The player's own houses (bought, or raised on a lot) let to townsfolk: each day a house on offer finds a tenant at tenantChance; a tenant pays rentPerDay[type] x rentMult each day, misses it at missChance (behindMult x that once already behind), paying back up to one day's arrears with each day paid; after leaveAfterMissed days unpaid they slip away. A warning when a tenant first misses and every warnEvery days behind; a summary of rents taken and paid every summaryDays. sellBack: what a lot (and a house on it) or a town house fetches when sold, of what it cost.
_propertyKinds: A property the player builds in a town stands on a lot of theirs (systems/lots.js claimLotForProperty: a bare lot they hold, else a free lot bought at its price), raised as a tile-composed building of the first of these kinds (CustomBuildings buildingType) that fits the lot, a house at the last (world/innerMap/lots.js). While it is being built it shows as a building site. Properties out in the country stand where their trade would put them (wildSites, below).
_wildSites: A property out in the country (no town on its hex) stands where its trade would put it, found on the hex's own map (world/innerMap/propertySites.js; hash-placed, the same each visit): site water = a mill on the riverbank, a gable wall against the stream and its wheel in a race along that wall's foot (with no river or lake it is built as `dry` says: windmill = on open ground well away from the water, sails turning on its roof); shore = against the water's edge; forest = in a clearing at the woods' edge; rock = against a crag's rock face (else on the stoniest ground); field = with a fenced field of `field` crops beside it; orchard = with a fenced orchard of `trees`; paddock = with a fenced paddock and its hay (big: a larger one); road = by the road, else near where the traveller comes in. kinds: the building types (CustomBuildings buildingType, 'farmstead' a farmhouse) it is built as, best first, else data/lots.json propertyKinds; props: what stands about its yard (data/townProps.json).
